author: toketrain
body:
Ok seriously why is there a height limit on walls maps. It limits making skybases, which is total bull because skybases on certain maps can be totally legitimate strategies and if you don't do them because "ur a pussy if u do lolol" that's your call. It's also just awful on some maps such as tetris jungle, where the treetops are at the height limit. I feel this severely limits gameplay and I have talked with other walls players and they agree. The point of the game is the fun and skybases are fun to do, plus you can already burn them down or climb up to them and shoot the people off or blow them up so they're limited in that sense.
It's also kind of pointless to generalize all maps to this standard, all maps are different from each other and the height limit can be good on some maps and bad on others. Anyone else have thoughts on this?

title: Walls Height Limit...?

replies.author: Eteh
replies.body: A height limit in Walls is a must. It stops players from entering another player's section before the walls drop. That's what I feel :p

replies.author: toketrain
replies.body: you can't enter another section, there is a region that protects leaving your own area before they drop.
replies.body_tagged: you can't enter another section, there is a region that protects leaving your own area before they drop.

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body: It was a terrible gameplay mechanic. Just because one guy would hide up 256 blocks in the sky meant for games to last up to 2 hours, if someone hadn't left. Most matches also were adapted to said tactic, and right before the decision was made to add boundaries basically every match was sky wars, and even worse with the maps we had in varying height and materials that encouraged this.

replies.author: Polar_Express
replies.body: I have no problem looking at all the maps and making sure the limit is not super low, but most map limits should be as we intended them to be. If some need to be a little higher I'll move them up. Thanks for bringing us your concerns, as we want everyone to have the best game play possible.
